node.title: Affine-core all-zero charge
node.statement: Under the affine-core cogirth hypotheses, fix a kernel-coordinate basis T and let p_T be the number of persistent zero coordinates outside T. Genericity gives p_T<=N-r-a-1. Every sparse error over T has at least N-r-a-p_T nonpersistent zeros, and those zero sets are disjoint across slopes. Hence at most r+1 pairs use T, proving |P|C(Delta-r+a-1,a)<=C(N,a)(r+1). Exact XR arithmetic pays full-domain selector ranks 4,4,4,11,11,10, closing rank four on all six rows without collision-line coverage.
